description: Pre-registered Analog Score config. Frozen by the commit 'freeze scoring config v1' before the first validation run. Any later change bumps 'version' and is logged in docs/METHOD_LOG.md.

desirability_types.lower_better: 1 at value <= full, 0 at value >= zero, linear in between
desirability_types.higher_better: 1 at value >= full, 0 at value <= zero, linear in between
desirability_types.band: trapezoid: 0 at <= zero_low, 1 between full_low and full_high, 0 at >= zero_high, linear in between

scoring.aggregation: weighted geometric mean of the dimension scores
scoring.limiting_dimension: argmin of the floored dimension scores; ties go to the first dimension in config order
scoring.missing_feature_policy: a land cell with any missing input feature is left unscored for that target
scoring.forbidden_features_note: Mission-only features; they feed the browser Mission Fit and never the Analog Score.

sensitivity.threshold_mode: each breakpoint shifted by U(-threshold_rel, +threshold_rel) x the span of its function (|full - zero| or zero_high - zero_low)

mars_jezero.note: Present-day arid, barren, thermally swinging sedimentary terrain. Mineralogy (carbonates/clays of the delta) is NOT captured globally.

dims.rationale: hyperarid ~<25 mm/yr
bare soil NDVI ~<0.1
Mars has no vegetated surface: most of the cell should be mapped as barren land
large thermal swing
moderate relief: crater/delta scale, not alpine
aeolian dust activity; weak dimension because column AOD is largely transported dust, not a local surface property

mars_arcadia.note: Mid-latitude plains with buried excess ice under dry regolith. Ice-sheet surfaces are NOT analogs, hence the snowice penalty.

dims.rationale: permafrost-supporting cold: mean annual surface temperature < 0 degC over all 12 months (no warm bias from missing polar-night daytime LST)
flat plains
polar desert
no vegetation in any month, as on the Martian plains
surface dominated by bare ground or snow/ice rather than plant cover
exclude glaciers/ice sheets: ice must be buried

moon_shackleton.note: Polar, extremely cold, rugged crater-rim relief, near-persistent illumination in season, no vegetation. Vacuum/temperatures far beyond Earth range.

dims.rationale: extreme cold; lunar polar temperatures lie far outside Earth's range, so this scale only ranks Earth's coldest surfaces
seasonal persistent sunlight
rim-like rugged relief
no vegetation or soil cover, as on the lunar surface
polar-desert dryness: the Moon has no precipitation
some ice in cold traps, not a full ice sheet: partial ice = full, ice-free = neutral (0.5 at 0 %), ice sheet = 0

moon_tranquillitatis_pit.note: Mare-basalt lava plains, where pits/lava tubes occur. Caves themselves and their thermal stability are NOT visible in global data; candidates need cross-checking with cave inventories.

dims.rationale: basaltic volcanic substrate
bare lava surfaces rather than plant cover
limits weathering/soil
little or no vegetation over the lava in any month
mare = plains

not_captured: Mineralogy (e.g. carbonates and clays at Jezero; hydromagnesite at Lake Salda)
Caves, pits and lava tubes, and their thermal stability
Subsurface ice depth and excess ground ice
Vacuum, atmospheric pressure, gravity and radiation environment
Features smaller than a 0.25 deg cell (~28 km at the equator)
